title: Team
seatsHelp: Owners, Admins and Agents each use a seat. Viewers are free. Suspending a member frees their seat at once.
readonly: Only Owners and Admins can invite or change members.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.warning: Members you invite can see your customers' conversations according to their role. Remove members the day they leave.
invite.linkText: Send this link to {email}. It works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.notEmailed: Email sending is not switched on yet, so please send the link yourself.

confirm.removeText: {name} loses access to {company} at once. What they did stays in the activity log.
confirm.suspendText: {name} cannot open {company} until you restore them. Their seat is freed.
confirm.leaveText: You lose access at once. An Owner or Admin can invite you again.

invitations.revokeText: The link stops working at once. You can invite them again later.

email.subject: You are invited to {company} on AIGen Hub

email.expiry: This link works once and expires in 7 days. If you did not expect it, ignore this email.
